Not one is the fold failing; each is a rule reaching no fold. A defect with a source site, per rule, and closing each is a wire change that owes R13 legs. OPC_PMON IS EXCLUDED BY THE RULE REGEX and that is a correction, not a carve-out: its 96 REG_ZERO rows are the same fact `mips-pmon-lsa` is RULED on -- an operand of an instruction this model does not have -- and holding them here gave one population two dispositions decided by which register a row happened to name. The exclusion is the narrowest thing that fixes it: one rule, named, so the ledger's two-class refusal still guards every other family. Of the 202 closed, 96 were the PMON family this row no longer claims and 106 were the DSP NOP and EXTRV arms 94d0331aaa and 209963934a state. What is left is the same shape and the same remedy: a decode rule that returns before the fold site is reached, per rule, each closing a wire change that owes R13 legs -- the fold notes reach most of the family and not all of it. The residue is a coverage list, not a disposition, and is tracked as such; the row is about the encodings the accessors do not reach.
